package.name: cobot_vision
package.description: Vision pipeline, split into two nodes: yolo_node — pure perception: YOLO-OBB on the latest color frame, publishes pixel-space detections; locates the red calibration dot on request. Only importer of ultralytics (pip dependency, no rosdep key). localization_node — pure geometry: fitted camera→robot calibration (px + depth → base-frame xyz, calibration.py), rz from corners, snake pick ordering. Owns the calibration math services (begin/sample/compute; task_manager drives the robot between them) and the cheap tier-1 depth checks (VerifyTarget, GetLayerHeight). Refuses to localize uncalibrated. Training/export tools live in vision_workspace/tools/ (dev-PC .venv), not here.
